identity.identity_result: Pinned contract and all independently recomputed RTL, testbench, Tcl, vector, retained simulation-log, and retained timing-report identities match the implementation reports.

finding_summary.statement: No P0, P1, P2, or P3 findings were identified within the frozen r2 module scope.

ready_valid_deadlock.rtl_evidence: CHECK_READY enters ISSUE from command and bank eligibility alone; request valid is asserted throughout ISSUE without dependence on executor ready; bank reservation occurs only on valid-and-ready acceptance.
ready_valid_deadlock.dynamic_evidence: Both DMA and GEMM consumers hold ready low before valid appears, check all 256 payload bits, hold backpressure for multiple cycles, then accept. The fresh XSIM regression reaches PASS.

gemm_destination_source_alias.rtl_evidence: GEMM legality explicitly requires dst != src0 and dst != src1. A violated comparison reaches E_OPERAND before ISSUE. Equal src0/src1 remains legal when dst is distinct.
gemm_destination_source_alias.dynamic_evidence: The alias command reaches error code 0x04 without issue or bank mutation; a subsequent equal-source/distinct-destination GEMM executes successfully under backpressure and applies its release flags.

requirement_coverage.requirement: One-cycle synchronous BRAM fetch, lower word then upper word
requirement_coverage.evidence: The BRAM model updates read data on enabled rising edges; RTL waits before capturing each word. Full 256-bit executor payload comparisons prove both word order and complete record assembly.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Never fetch the next command before current successful completion
requirement_coverage.evidence: RTL returns to FETCH_LO only from a successful WAIT_COMPLETION response. The self-checking monitor fatals on fetch while outstanding, and the blocked-current test observes exactly two word fetches with no lookahead.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Valid before ready and stable payload through backpressure
requirement_coverage.evidence: DMA and GEMM tasks hold ready low until valid, compare all 256 bits, retain ready low for multiple cycles while rechecking valid and payload, then handshake.

requirement_coverage.requirement: PC advances once only after matching successful completion; maximum one outstanding
requirement_coverage.evidence: RTL transition audit and dynamic outstanding monitor confirm one outstanding. Error and tag-mismatch tests retain the current PC; successful non-final completion increments once.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Atomic bank reservation, rollback, and release
requirement_coverage.evidence: Reservations update on request handshake. DMA_STORE failure restores READY. GEMM failure preserves both READY sources and faults the destination despite release flags. Equal-source GEMM success frees the source and readies the distinct destination.
Destination/source alias dynamically errors without issue; equal sources with a distinct destination dynamically succeed. Both destination comparison predicates are present in synthesized RTL source.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Reset in every active FSM state
requirement_coverage.evidence: The testbench reaches FETCH_LO, FETCH_HI, CHECK_READY, ISSUE, and WAIT_COMPLETION individually, applies synchronous reset, and checks idle/free state plus absence of stale request/fetch activity.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Command-count limits and full BRAM extent
requirement_coverage.evidence: 0 and 1025 reject. A 1024-command alternating LOAD/STORE program executes to current_pc 1023; the address checker and final full-payload comparison cover the last instruction at BRAM words 2046 and 2047.
Two complete releasable programs run successively without reset after all banks return FREE.
